name: inventory_middle_drag_after_right_drag
about: On one screen: a right-button drag of the 4 cursor stone over slots 20 and 21 (one each), then a middle-button drag over slots 9 and 10: 1.7.10 repeats the previous drag's button codes (one stone per slot, cursor empty), 1.8.9 sends the middle-drag codes and rejects it (cursor keeps 2).
